topic: Day 42 — carousel — The deepest intimacy lives in ordinary moments, not grand gestures

slides.text: Not in the grand gesture designed to impress.
Grand gestures are performative and infrequent.
Being known on a Tuesday carries more weight over time.

caption:
A quiet Tuesday evening where someone sees you exactly as you are builds more real closeness than any elaborate gesture.

Follow for one of these a day.
